description: Reports a job you took done, with the same session you took it with. For each item: its public link (links), the reason you left it out (skipped, on a job whose steps say to use it), or, on a job whose homework_get lists outcomes, one of them (outcomes, with its link or where it stopped as that outcome asks); on a photos job or an end card job, the items you sent files for go in sent. Every item needs one, except one already settled in Marsell while you held the job (homework_get shows it skipped). Your report is the answer the owner gives on the work's own card, and whoever answers first is the answer: said tells you what was kept for each item. Setting up a Google Ads account is reported with no items, and Marsell refuses it with why until it sees the Google Ads connection (the owner still presses Connect Google Ads); it also closes that job on its own once it does.

links.description: One entry per item you posted: its ref and the public https link it went out at.

notes.description: Anything the owner should know about the job.

outcomes.description: On a job that lists outcomes only: the items that ended another way, each with its outcome's key, and its link (url) or where it stopped or why (where) when that outcome asks for it.

outcome.description: One of the job's outcomes, by its key.

url.description: An https:// address, when the outcome takes a link.

where.description: Where it stopped, or why, when the outcome asks.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

saw.description: A batch of posts a site warned about after some went out (the rest in skipped): what it showed, banner (a warning), captcha, rate_limit or restricted. Marsell then slows or stops that platform's missions, as on homework_stuck.

sent.description: A photos job or an end card job only: the refs of the items you sent files for through get_upload_link.

session.description: A short name for this wake of yours (letters, digits, dots, dashes, colons or underscores, up to 64), made up once when the wake starts and passed the same to homework_take and every report of that job. A job is held for the session that took it: another session is refused it, and only the session that took it reports it. Without it, a job your key already holds is refused to a second take, so two wakes never do it twice.

skipped.description: The items you left out, each with why, only on a job whose steps say to use skipped; where one of the job's outcomes fits the item, that outcome instead.

why.description: Why you left it out, in plain words.

name: homework_done
title: Report a homework job done
